prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A striking, cinematic scene featuring a young man with platinum white hair, styled neatly, standing with his back to the camera and his head turned slightly to the side, revealing his profile. He wears a tailored, high-collared white suit with intricate silver embroidery along the collar and shoulders, exuding a futuristic and regal aesthetic. The lighting is cool and even, casting soft shadows that enhance the crispness of his attire and the pale tone of his hair. The background is a modern, minimalist interior with sleek, dark walls and a hint of teal accent, creating a stark contrast with the subject’s light clothing. A blurred figure is visible in the distance, reflected in a glass or mirror, adding depth and a subtle sense of intrigue to the composition. The camera angle is at shoulder height, focusing on the subject’s upper body and emphasizing the clean lines and textures of the scene. The overall mood is sophisticated and enigmatic, with a color palette dominated by whites, silvers, and cool blues, evoking a sense of high fashion or a science fiction narrative.
